title: Comprehensive operating review system
problem_statement: Current audits are fragmented; no unified recurring review across system/setup/infrastructure/workflow/process and Command Center product surface.
objective: Implement comprehensive recurring operating review with explicit keep/improve/remove outcomes and run next available cycle immediately.

current_state.blast_radius: Low: adds script/reporting and cron job only.

options_considered.tradeoffs: Fastest safe path with clear evolution

selected_solution.rationale: Best-fit balance of reliability, speed, and low operational risk.

guardrails.retry_backoff: Cron-level retry behavior retained; no tight polling loops introduced.
guardrails.fallback: If APIs unavailable, report still generated with failure markers.
guardrails.rollback: Remove script + cron job and keep existing audit jobs only.

restart.reason: No gateway config apply/update action required.

completion.summary: Implemented comprehensive operating review script, generated immediate report, scheduled weekly Discord-delivered review, and posted completion update to Discord.
